description:
Cheetah vs Falcon: Who Hits 240 MPH in a Race?! — Wait—don't bet on the cheetah! Something diving from the clouds hits 240 mph!
Kids science answer for "fastest animal in the world for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Cheetahs sprint fastest on land around 60-70 mph, while a diving peregrine falcon plunges faster than 200 mph (over 240 mph recorded).

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
